info.name: Get a Work Request by its external reference (ERP Reference)

params.name: externalReference
params.description: Work Request external reference (ERP Reference). Must be URL encoded.

params.name: associations
params.description: Define which associations should be included in the response.

items.docs: Retrieves a single Work Request identified by its external reference (ERP Reference). Optionally include associated resources via query parameters.

info.name: Update a Work Request by its external reference (ERP Reference)

params.name: externalReference
params.description: Work Request external reference (ERP Reference). Must be URL encoded.

info.name: Delete a Work Request by its external reference (ERP Reference)

params.description: Work Request external reference (ERP Reference). Must be URL encoded.

items.docs: Permanently deletes a Work Request identified by its external reference (ERP Reference). Returns 204 on success or 404 if no matching Work Request exists.

info.name: Get a list of Work Requests

params.name: page
params.description: Page number.

params.name: limit
params.description: Define how many items will be received in the payload per request (default 20 items, max 1000 items).

params.name: status
params.description: Filter Work Requests by status. 000_new, 010_approved, 020_declined, 030_completed.

params.name: relatedAssetId
params.description: Filter Work Requests by Asset internal ID.

params.name: assetStatus
params.description: Filter Work Requests by Asset status. new, running, warning, stopped, inactive.

params.name: updatedAtFrom
params.description: Filter Work Requests updated from this date.

params.name: updatedAtUntil
params.description: Filter Work Requests updated until this date.

params.name: createdAtFrom
params.description: Filter Work Requests created from this date.

params.name: createdAtUntil
params.description: Filter Work Requests created until this date.

params.name: failureTypeIds
params.description: Filter Work Requests by failure type internal IDs.

params.name: failureTypeReferences
params.description: Filter Work Requests by failure type external references (ERP References).

params.name: externalReference
params.description: Filter Work Requests by external reference (ERP Reference).

params.name: relatedWorkOrderId
params.description: Filter Work Requests by related Work Order internal ID.

items.docs: Returns a paginated list of Work Requests. Use query parameters to filter, sort, and paginate results.
Creates a new Work Request with the provided details. Supports multipart/form-data to allow file attachments alongside the request body. Returns the internal ID of the created Work Request.
